i.norm: Verifies that {@link SparseBloomFilter#copy()} produces a distinct object that is equal to the original in every observable property: bit-map contents, index contents, cardinality, characteristics, estimated population, shape, emptiness, and fullness. When {@code assertClass} is {@code true} the copy is also required to be the same runtime type as the original.
